reports.title: BD Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full Year Fiscal 2027 Guidance
section: The company provides the following guidance with respect to fiscal 2027.

GAAP Revenue Growth | Low single-digit
Revenue Growth (FXN) | Low single-digit
Adjusted Diluted EPS | $13.10 to $13.30

BD's guidance for full year fiscal 2027 reflects numerous assumptions that could affect its business, based on the information management has reviewed as of this date. Management will discuss its guidance and several of its assumptions on its fourth fiscal quarter earnings call.

desk.period: Q4 fiscal 2026 (quarter to 30 Sep 2026; full year to 30 Sep 2026)
desk.headline: Q4 revenue up 5.4% to $5.3bn, adjusted EPS $4.15 beat; first FY27 outlook of $13.10–13.30 adjusted EPS, midpoint a little under estimates
results: Q4 revenue rose 5.4% to $5.3bn (5.6% excluding currency); the US grew 4.3% and international 7.6% currency-neutral.
All four segments grew: Interventional +7.6%, BioPharma Systems +7.0% and Medical Essentials +5.9% currency-neutral; Connected Care lagged at +2.1% as medication management sales slipped 2.2%.
Adjusted EPS jumped 27% to $4.15; GAAP EPS from continuing operations was $2.52, up from $1.20 when legal charges were heavy.
For fiscal 2026 (now excluding the life sciences unit spun into Waters in February) revenue was $19.5bn, adjusted EPS $12.70 and free cash flow $2.9bn, up 42.5%.
BD bought back $2.4bn of shares in the year, paid $1.2bn in dividends and cut long-term debt to $13.4bn from $17.6bn.

guidance.summary: BD gave its first fiscal 2027 outlook: low single-digit revenue growth (currency a drag of about 0.7 points) and adjusted EPS of $13.10–13.30, up 3–5%. Coverage said the EPS midpoint was about 0.8% under analysts' forecasts.

points: The main FY27 drag is lapping a strong year of Alaris infusion pump sales: about 2 points off revenue growth and a big hit to EPS growth, expected to fade in FY28.
Operating and gross margins are guided roughly flat; tariffs are assumed at about this year's cost, and possible Section 232 tariff relief from the US government deal is not in the outlook.
Q1 growth should be at the low end of the range, with earnings growth picking up from Q2.
Vaccine-related sales fell about 11% in Q4 and that headwind should largely fade; China was described as stable.
Capital use will mix buybacks and further debt reduction; net leverage ended at 2.7x, and long-term targets come at the 10 December investor day.
call.source: Q4 FY26 call transcript (Earnings Whispers, 5 Nov 2026) and StockStory, 5 Nov 2026

watch: Whether Section 232 tariff relief is confirmed around year-end and added to guidance.
Long-term targets at the 10 December 2026 investor day.
How quickly growth recovers once the Alaris comparison eases.
